purpose: Evocation token portrait pilot; rings and copy numbers drawn by Godot, no alteration of source cards

assets.prompt:
Create a single square game UI portrait asset derived from the supplied reference card. Preserve the creature's established identity, anatomy, colors and costume closely. Use ONLY the creature illustration as reference, ignore every letter, symbol, border and rules panel on the card. Tight centered head-and-shoulders composition, face/helmet and distinctive horns occupying most of the square; all identity-defining features inside a central circular safe area with 8% breathing space. Painterly dark fantasy, sculptural lighting, readable broad shapes, crisp silhouette, restrained fine detail. Very dark neutral charcoal background, no scene clutter. Strong separation between head and backdrop, designed to remain recognizable when displayed inside a 36-pixel circular token. Absolutely NO text, NO numbers, NO UI, NO medallion, NO frame, NO ring, NO symbols. This file is the portrait only; the application adds all borders and identifiers. Do not depict a physical card.

Helmet front in a gentle three-quarter view; do not turn it into a face or skull.
